How to go from 0 to 10K followers with Claude, without begging anyone to follow you 🔥

Step 1: Build your growth engine. Connect Reachlee to Claude once. It reads your posts and comments and learns what your audience keeps asking for.

Step 2: Claude ranks your posts by comments. Use only the ones people already want more from. Those are your follower magnets.

Step 3: Turn on the Growth Gate. Someone comments your keyword, gets a DM, and the link only unlocks once they follow you. Every comment becomes a follower.

Step 4: Send it to everyone who commented in the last 7 days, then let Claude rank which keyword brought the most follows and double down on it.

Comment GROWTH and I’ll send you the exact Claude prompt that finds your best posts and sets up the Growth Gate for you. Save this for your next 30 days.
